framework.constraints: No physical network or dispatch constraints

framework.convergence: No proof of global optimality or escaping local minima
framework.implementation_match: not_assessed: no code link or executed implementation

dataset.externality: Single region; not cross-region external testing
dataset.availability: p21 says Not applicable despite AEMO named in Methods; exact dataset file/version/code link not supplied

Declared contiguous train dates imply 78,983 half-hour rows, not 78,883; 100-row discrepancy

quality_findings.finding: LSTM average 1.93 differs from 12 printed monthly values' arithmetic mean 1.8316667; claimed 41.4% reduction uses disputed mean
Feature importance described as gain-based then feature replacement by random noise; two distinct procedures not reconciled
Softmax final layer does not directly explain unrestricted continuous MW forecasts without output transformation; no mapping specified
Pseudocode assignment indices and missing centroid update differ from described k-means
Six unadjusted signed-rank tests without paired unit/sample size/tie convention; confidence intervals absent
Avoiding local minima is asserted without supporting experiment/proof
Normalization text says mean and unit variance zero, an internally inconsistent specification; likely wording error but exact operation unknown
